name: push-guard
description: Bounded pre-push code safety review skill and hook for Codex and Claude Code.

interface.shortDescription: Block git push until a structured safety review is present
interface.longDescription: Push Guard provides manual review profiles, L0/L1/L2 diff-risk tiers, and a bounded PASS/BLOCK/NOTE pre-push review for Codex and Claude Code. Strict mode retains the legacy seven-dimension checklist.
defaultPrompt: Run a pre-push safety review for this repository
